meta.title: VIS — Digital Content Platform
meta.description: VIS helps creators, businesses and organizations organize and publish digital content across supported social platforms.
meta.keywords: VIS, Viral Intelligence System, content platform, social media content, digital publishing, content management

hero.title: Create, organize and publish
hero.description: VIS helps creators, businesses and organizations organize digital content and publish it across supported social platforms from one clear workspace.

platform.title: A simpler way to manage digital content
platform.description: VIS brings content creation, organization and publishing together in one clear environment so teams can spend less time on repetitive tasks and more time on the content itself.
platform.creationText: Prepare digital content efficiently while keeping creative decisions and final approval in your hands.
platform.managementText: Keep content, supporting materials and publishing information organized in one consistent workspace.
platform.publishingText: Publish through supported account connections while maintaining control over where and when your content is used.

capabilities.title: Built around everyday content work
capabilities.description: VIS is designed for creators, companies and organizations that want a clear and practical way to manage content across supported platforms.
capabilities.multiPlatformText: Keep preparation, organization and publishing together in one consistent experience.
capabilities.responsibleText: VIS is built around account ownership, user choice and clear control of connected services.
responsibleItems: You decide which accounts to connect
You remain in control of access

security.title: Your accounts remain under your control
security.description: VIS connects to supported third-party services only with the account owner's authorization. You choose what to connect and can revoke access when needed.

items.title: No social media passwords requested
items.text: VIS does not ask you to provide the password for a connected social media account.

items.title: Authorized connections only
items.text: VIS works only with accounts that their owners have chosen to connect.

items.title: Owner-controlled access
items.text: Account owners remain in control of their connected services.

items.title: Clear policies
items.text: Privacy and service terms explain how VIS handles connected accounts and related data.

security.noticeText: VIS does not sell personal data and does not guarantee views, reach, followers, revenue or approval by third-party platforms.

policies.title: Clear information for every VIS user
policies.description: Review the VIS Privacy Policy and Terms of Service to understand the rules that apply to the public service.

contact.title: Questions about VIS?
contact.description: Contact the VIS team for service, privacy or account-related questions.

footer.description: VIS helps creators, businesses and organizations organize and publish digital content across supported social platforms.
